title: 大阪杯の後に・ライバルの帰国

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black blows past the competition in the Osaka Hai. Her performance inspires Satono Diamond as she prepares for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, her rival Brusquement has returned from a successful international racing tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black sets the spring Tenno Sho as her next goal, but she seems to be keeping a close eye on Brusquement's aspirations as well.
